description: Helps you decide who else must agree before a deal can close. You give what you sell, the deal size, the company size, your champion and any stakeholders you know. You get a buying group map with your stakeholders placed by their titles (economic buyer, technical evaluator, reviewers, users), each role's concern and message prompts, an influence map and discovery questions, with sector roles and questions when your inputs name a supported sector. Roles from titles are hypotheses to confirm.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge (software subscription, services, connectivity, per transaction, marketplace, hardware plus software, or investment management). Read from your other inputs when left out

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it

confirmed_budget_owner.description: Optional confirmed fact: the person or role who owns the budget for this purchase. Ask the user; do not infer from title. Overrides candidate ordering.

known_stakeholders.description: Roles you know are involved. A title suggests a role, not confirmed authority. Confirm who owns this purchase budget.

name: buyer_group_analyzer
